name: print-social-dark-moody-cocktail-photo-event-cover-with-heavy-white-title
title: Moody Cocktail Photo Event Cover
whatItIs: An Instagram carousel slide of a dark film-grain photo of hands holding a coupe glass over a whisky glass, with a small white logo top left, an outlined location pill, a heavy white sans headline 'XCHANGE FASHION SIP + SWAP: LUNAR NEW YEAR EDITION', a venue and date line and an arrow at the lower right.
whatItMeans: Warm low light and hands in the frame feel intimate and social, and blunt heavy type reads instantly over the dark photo.
techniques: Heavy white caps headline set low left
Smaller venue and date under the title
Arrow cue for the next slide

vocabulary.definition: Visible noise giving photos an analog feel.
An outlined capsule naming the city.
Type placed directly on a darkened image.
